# GitHub Copilot instructions for DrivePerf

Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. It is the single source of truth for every coding agent in
this repository (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot) and DrivePerf owns it. Path-specific rules are in
[`.github/instructions/`](instructions/).

The essentials, in case only this file is loaded:
- Put the Jira key (`DRIVE-<n>`) in every branch, commit message, PR title and PR description.
- Read the ticket's acceptance criteria in `docs/product/PRD-v1.md` and its designs in `docs/design/<JIRA-KEY>/`.
- `docs/architecture/adr/*` and `docs/product/decisions.md` win over any other document.
- App IDs are `com.driveperf.app` (dev `com.driveperf.app.dev`); minimum iOS 26 and Android 10. Never commit secrets.
- Open PRs as drafts, get CI green, then mark them ready. Never merge, and never push changes to `.github/workflows/`.

This file used to be generated by the `agentic-workflow` harness. DrivePerf was detached from it on 2026-11-11
(DRIVE-210); edit this file here, and never run `agentic-workflow/install/sync-instructions.sh` against this repository.
